edges.sentence: On 2026-10-02, UPI reported “Five people were killed on the ground Sept. 6 when the Boeing 767, which was operated by cargo carrier 21Air, overran the runway and struck multiple vehicles on the ground.”; on the same day, USA Today reported “An air traffic controller did not provide required information about tailwind conditions to the pilots of an Amazon cargo plane before it overran a runway at Miami International Airport and crashed last month, killing five people on the ground, according to a preliminary federal report released Oct. 1.”.

On 2026-10-02, UPI reported “It hit a passenger van, killing five inside, and then a SUV.”; on the same day, UPI reported “Five people were killed on the ground Sept. 6 when the Boeing 767, which was operated by cargo carrier 21Air, overran the runway and struck multiple vehicles on the ground.”.

On 2026-10-02, UPI reported “It hit a passenger van, killing five inside, and then a SUV.”; on the same day, USA Today reported “An air traffic controller did not provide required information about tailwind conditions to the pilots of an Amazon cargo plane before it overran a runway at Miami International Airport and crashed last month, killing five people on the ground, according to a preliminary federal report released Oct. 1.”.

new_slots.sentence: The Boeing 767, a 32-year-old freighter that previously operated in passenger service before being converted for cargo operations, was carrying more than 32,000 pounds of cargo that consisted primarily of contact lenses, according to NTSB Chair Jennifer Homendy.
